FORM GST ASMT-10 INTIMATION OF DISCREPANCY IN RETURN AFTER SCRUTINY
Notice Reference No: ASMT10/DL/2023/1515 | Date of Notice: 30-11-2023
GSTIN: 07AAABB1234A1Z1 | Legal Name: M/s Capital Logistics & Trading
Financial Year: 2022-23

1. Statutory Scrutiny of Returns: M/s Capital Logistics & Trading (hereinafter referred to as the 'taxable person') is registered under Delhi GST. In terms of Section 61 of the CGST Act, 2017 read with Rule 99 of the CGST Rules, 2017, the monthly returns and third-party data of the taxable person for the Financial Year 2022-23 were selected for automated scrutiny.

2. Cross-Verification of E-Way Bill Data vs GSTR-3B Turnover: Automated cross-matching of E-Way Bill portal data with Form GSTR-3B returns filed by the taxable person revealed significant variation in outward supply values. The total consignment value of e-way bills generated as outward supply during FY 2022-23 stood at Rs. 85,00,000/-, whereas the taxable turnover reported in Form GSTR-3B was only Rs. 65,00,000/-.

3. Discrepancy & Unrecorded Turnover Summary Table:
Financial Year | E-Way Bill Generated Turnover (Rs.) | GSTR-3B Reported Turnover (Rs.) | Unrecorded Turnover Discrepancy (Rs.) | Estimated Tax Liability @18% (Rs.)
2022-23 | 85,00,000/- | 65,00,000/- | 20,00,000/- | 3,60,000/-

4. Statutory Contravention & Omission: The discrepancy of Rs. 20,00,000/- indicates potential suppression of outward sales turnover and non-payment of GST, in contravention of Section 9(1) and Section 39 of the CGST Act, 2017.

5. Intimation of Tax & Interest Liability: The taxable person is hereby informed of the aforesaid discrepancy under Rule 99(1). The estimated tax liability on the suppressed turnover amounts to Rs. 3,60,000/- (CGST Rs. 1,80,000/- + SGST Rs. 1,80,000/-) along with interest under Section 50(1).

6. Explanation & Rectification Directions: The taxable person is requested to accept the discrepancy and pay the tax and interest through Form GST DRC-03, or submit an explanation in Form GST ASMT-11 within thirty (30) days of receipt of this notice.
